text:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the FlashAttention RFC: we're seeing puzzling memory spikes on v3 for medium sequences (128-512). Anyone else?
Aj: Saw that on dedicated infra, repro on A100 80GB. v2 stays stable, v3 uses more workspace at step start.
Cheng: Can you paste the config and shapes?
Maria: Config we used:
```json
{"model":"llama-2-13b","dtype":"fp16","batch":8,"seq":256,"kv_cache":true,"workspace_pool":"ephemeral","flashattn_version":"v3"}
```
Aj: TL;DR numbers from local perf run: v2 peak GPU mem 31.0 GB, v3 peak 34.5 GB (+11%). Throughput: v3 wins for long sequences (>=1024) by ~8–12% but loses for short/medium seqs at small batch sizes.
Sasha: That matches the theory: v3 does larger temporary allocations to reduce kernel latency, so it favors throughput at the cost of workspace. We need kernel selection heuristics that consider both headroom and tail latency.
Cheng: Proposal: add a selector that uses (free_mem, seq, batch, model_size) -> prefer_v3 if free_mem > X AND seq > Y. Also allow configured overrides per workload.
Maria: Also seeing GC-like pauses in host pinned memory from workspace allocation churn when pool is ephemeral.
Aj: Can we pool the workspace across requests? Current ephemeral pool allocates/destroys per-request which fragments.
Sasha: Runtime already has a workspace-pool RFC in planning, but v3 integration wasn't included. Action: unify v3 workspace into the pool and add LRU eviction + max-resident-ws per GPU.
Cheng: Another low-level win: v3 rounds workspace up to 256B or 1KB chunks depending on kernel path — for short sequences that rounding dominates. We should add a "compact rounding" mode that uses finer-grained rounding for seq < 128.
Maria: Quick experiment: enabling compact rounding + shared workspace_pool reduced v3 peak by ~9% and smoothed latency stddev by ~30% on our test harness.
Aj: Concrete action items:
- Cheng: prototype pooled workspace + compact rounding for v3 (ETA 2w)
- Sasha: add a kernel-selector config flag (heuristic thresholds + per-customer override) and unit tests (ETA 1w)
- Maria: run full perf grid (batch:1/4/8/16 × seq:16/64/256/1024/2048) and collect mem/latency deltas, upload traces (ETA 3d)
infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-1234 — "flashattn-v3 workspace pool + selector"
Sasha: One more thought: expose per-customer kernel_preference so enterprise customers can lock to v2 for deterministic memory footprints.
Cheng: Also observed an indexing corner: v3's indexing kernel creates an O(seq^2) temporary when the activation tensor has non-contiguous 2D strides. Add a layout-normalization pass in the compiler to prefer contiguous layout for QKV before kernel selection.
Maria: Great — once Cheng has a prototype I'll try on Dedicated and Private clusters. I'll post perf logs back here. :thumbsup:
